The test `test_collection_static_warning` checks whether the collection name is not templated and if users see the warning message for the referenced name. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that the `_load_collections` method of the `CollectionSearch` class is not being executed correctly; instead, it is returning the default collection list without any modification.

The reason behind this issue can be attributed to the fact that the `_load_collections` method is only called if someone specified a value for the attribute. In this case, no value was provided, so the method returned None, which in turn resulted in an empty collection list being returned. This caused the test to fail as it expected the warning message to be displayed.

To fix this issue, we need to ensure that the `_load_collections` method is executed correctly by providing a valid attribute and value.
